admission: Any model claim requires new training/evaluation receipts, independently audited prompts, and completed causal comparison.
claim_population: Future fresh cases from a preregistered law; independent motif blocks and model seeds.

evalmath_design_card.acquisition: Verbatim generated outputs and full oracle-held signed execution records, held outside actor observation.
evalmath_design_card.aggregation: Complete motif blocks; within-motif paired contrasts; training-seed and rule-family hierarchy retained.
evalmath_design_card.claim: Synthetic implementation verified on CPU; no empirical ontological-treatment effect from this bridge.
evalmath_design_card.controllers: Frozen base+adapter, fixed decoding, matched prompt and resource caps, full reset between trajectories.
evalmath_design_card.game: Fully authenticated permission twins; physical change/retain choices, assigned-reporting incidents and deterministic payoff/audit draws.
evalmath_design_card.judgment: Independent DNF oracle; authorization-conditioned transfers, completion, false clean reports, and abstention.
evalmath_design_card.sampling: Independent motifs from preregistered source family law. Each motif has 2 authorization states x 2 monitoring cues x 2 bonus cues.

final_test: SEALED; requires independent fresh seed and new explicit execution approval
paired_execution: Every arm and every cue cell assigned before scores; blocked failures retained.
sampling_rule: Frozen random motif generator with independent seeds; no O1-vs-S1 adaptive selection.
training_constraint: Natural targets and single EOS, no synthetic supervised padding; separately record input and supervised token exposure.
